TABLE.NAME: local_lmshomepage_reminders
TABLE.COMMENT: Throttle tracking — one row per student+course+risk_level to prevent duplicate sends

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user ID of the student

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle course ID

FIELD.NAME: risk_level
FIELD.COMMENT: Risk level: low, medium, or high

FIELD.NAME: timesent
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of most recent send at this level

TABLE.NAME: local_lmshomepage_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Full audit log of every attendance notification sent — used for the admin report

FIELD.NAME: timesent
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when notification was dispatched

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user ID of the student being reported on

FIELD.NAME: student_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Student full name at time of send (cached for reporting)

FIELD.NAME: student_email
FIELD.COMMENT: Student email at time of send

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle course ID

FIELD.NAME: course_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Course full name at time of send (cached for reporting)

FIELD.NAME: activity_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Attendance activity name

FIELD.NAME: risk_level
FIELD.COMMENT: Risk level: low, medium, or high

FIELD.NAME: percentage
FIELD.COMMENT: Student attendance percentage at time of send

FIELD.NAME: kpi_threshold
FIELD.COMMENT: KPI threshold that was breached

FIELD.NAME: recipient_type
FIELD.COMMENT: Who received the message: student, teacher, or admin

FIELD.NAME: recipient_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user ID of recipient (0 for external admin email)

FIELD.NAME: recipient_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Recipient display name or email address

FIELD.NAME: subject
FIELD.COMMENT: Email subject line that was sent

TABLE.NAME: local_lmshomepage_commhub
TABLE.COMMENT: CommHub communication log — one row per automated notification sent by LMS Hosting Services (M7/M8/M9)

FIELD.NAME: timesent
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when notification was sent

FIELD.NAME: studentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user ID of the student

FIELD.NAME: student_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Student full name at time of send

FIELD.NAME: student_email
FIELD.COMMENT: Student email at time of send

FIELD.NAME: trainerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user ID of trainer (0 if not applicable)

FIELD.NAME: trainer_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Trainer full name at time of send

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Related Moodle course ID

FIELD.NAME: course_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Course full name at time of send

FIELD.NAME: assessment_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Assessment or activity name

FIELD.NAME: channel
FIELD.COMMENT: Delivery channel: email, sms, or moodle

FIELD.NAME: message_subject
FIELD.COMMENT: Message subject line

FIELD.NAME: message_body
FIELD.COMMENT: Full message body text

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Delivery status: sent, failed, or pending
